title: Bonfire: Vanilla+ Tempest Edition
description: A definitive Vanilla+ overhaul featuring physics-based weather and vast exploration. Chase storms with ProtoManly’s Weather, discover overhauled dimensions, and embark on a high-fidelity adventure across an atmospheric world.
body:
# Bonfire: Vanilla+ Tempest Edition

This modpack provides a high-fidelity refinement of the Minecraft experience, balancing technical depth with a grounded aesthetic. Built for **NeoForge 1.21.1**, it transforms the world into a living, atmospheric environment while maintaining a true "Vanilla+" feel.

## The Meteorological Overworld

Experience a world where nature is a force to be reckoned with.

* **Advanced Volumetric Systems**: Utilizing **ProtoManly’s Weather**, global weather cycles are completely replaced by raymarched, data-driven atmospheric systems. Watch real-time storm structures develop, producing fluid, highly detailed cloud layers, shifting wind patterns, and localized squalls.
* **Extreme Storm Events**: True survival means building for the elements. Track active fronts using specialized meteorological radar equipment, radomes (WSR-88D), and anemometers, and fortify your homestead against high-velocity supercells, destructive cyclones, and high- International Fujita scale tornadoes that actively alter the landscape.
* **Vibrant World-Gen**: Shifting from procedural terrain to deeply integrated, resource-rich landscapes, **Biomes O' Plenty** and **BetterNether** add massive overhauls to both the surface world and the underworld, complete with native wood variants.
* **Atmospheric Immersion**: **Sound Physics Remastered** and **Noisium** provide realistic echoes and optimized cloud rendering, ensuring the environment feels as heavy as it looks.
* **Living Ecosystems & Depths**: **Hybrid Aquatic**, **Naturalist**, and **Critters and Companions** populate the land and sea with realistic wildlife. The waterways are given unprecedented depth through **Tide 2** and **Aquaculture 2**, introducing biome-specific fish, interactive reel-in minigames, and unique nautical treasures.

---

## Legendary RPG Progression

Surviving the storm is only the beginning. Build your character and conquer the world’s most dangerous threats.

* **Lookin' Sharp (Weapon Mastery)**: Master a dedicated suite of high-fidelity, beautifully animated 3D weaponry that elevates tactile blade combat. Forge and upgrade a distinct, martial arsenal of specialized blades, including the **Scythe**, **Honed Sword**, **Shortsword**, **Cleaver**, **Spear**, **Broad Sword**, **Cutlass**, **Gladius**, and **Great Sword**.
* **Bosses of Mass Destruction**: Track down rare, ancient entities hidden across the dimensions. Defeat the Night Lich in frozen towers, uncover the Nether Gauntlet, challenge the Obsidilith in the End, or unearth the toxic Void Blossom deep below the bedrock.
* **The Relic System**: Utilizing **Relics** and **Artifacts**, you can discover and level up unique items found in the world. Defeating legendary threats yields rare components to drastically enhance your baseline capabilities.

---

## Arcane & Ancient Magic

Expand upon Minecraft’s untapped potential with a dedicated magical progression.

* **Eidolon: Repraised**: Adds proper, dark-themed magic that draws on alchemy and theurgy. Perform rituals and commune with unknown forces through a system that feels like a natural extension of the game's lore.

---

## Adventure & Mobility Revamped

Every dimension and structure has been carefully updated to encourage discovery.

* **The Aether**: Travel to the legendary sky dimension, featuring unique biomes like the **Deep Aether**, settlement-filled **Aether Villages**, and specialized gear for aerial survival.
* **The Otherside (Deeper and Darker)**: Break through the Warden's domain into an ancient, echo-filled realm. This dimension acts as an endgame echo of the Deep Dark, featuring alien sculk ecosystems, corrupted ruins, and deep subterranean mysteries.
* **The Undergarden**: Descend into a vast, subterranean ecosystem untouched by cosmic light. This desolate, ancient world features unique twilight vegetation, its own subterranean gear progression, and strange, primitive entities specialized for survival in the dark.
* **Reimagined End**: Experience a total overhaul of the final frontier with **BetterEnd**, adding lush, alien biomes and mysterious structures that transform the End into a vibrant, living world.
* **Legendary Structures**: All of **YUNG’s Better Series** are included, overhauling temples, dungeons, and mineshafts into massive, complex adventures.
* **Aviation & Exploration Utilities**: Take to the skies with **Immersive Aircraft**, engineering and piloting a custom fleet of functional, mechanical flying vessels for high-altitude traversal. Combine aerial travel with **Yori3o’s Grappling Hooks** and **Gliders** for total multi-directional mobility, and rely on **Nature’s Compass** or **Explorer’s Compass** to locate key structural landmarks.

---

## Culinary & Utility Excellence

The "Farmer’s Delight" family brings a professional and rewarding progression to survival.

* **The Delight Suite**: A massive culinary overhaul featuring **Farmer’s Delight** along with specialized addons for the **Aether**, **Nether**, and **End**, ensuring you stay fed regardless of which dimension you’re in.
* **Dietary Milestones**: Powered by a custom configured **Spice of Life Onion**, the server completely bypasses the chore of rotating meals. Instead, it acts as a permanent tracker—every unique *Farmer's Delight* dish or dimensional delicacy you discover logs progress toward permanent, un-decaying extra hearts.
* **Functional Visuals & Tools**: **Visual Workbench**, **Easy Anvils**, and **Jade** provide an immersive way to interact with your tools, while **Only Paxels** provides a clean, tag-based 3-in-1 tool framework to clear up hotbar clutter.

---

## Performance Optimized

Designed for professional-grade stability and high frame rates.

* **Technical Stack**: Powered by **Lithium**, **ModernFix**, and **FerriteCore** to ensure smooth chunk management and efficient memory usage, ensuring clean multi-threaded tick tracking even with 200+ mods.
